title: Fix dashboard CLI compile regression before dispatch
description: The pasted transcript and local reproduction showed every dashboard-related bwrk command failing before dispatch with TransformError: await can only be used inside an async function at apps/cli/src/commands.ts:2186. TypeScript also reported command-file status typing regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk dashboard global --json, bwrk sprint list --json, and bwrk doctor --view dashboard run through the installed bwrk binary.
Add or preserve regression coverage for work split/edit/cancel/reopen command compilation so this cannot break every dashboard command again.
closedReason: CLI compile regression repaired and covered by TypeScript plus lifecycle/dashboard command tests
